title: Manicure, Pedicure and Wine Tasting Experience
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This is the perfect place for friends to connect, celebrate and get glamorous, all while enjoying fine wines and delicious snacks. Our unique group focus allows us to turn your spa visit in to an unforgettable experience with your favourite people. 

Your journey with us begins at our wine bar, where our sommelier will guide you through a comparative tasting to help you select the perfect beverage for your visit. From there, your group will transition to one of our treatment rooms for your chosen beauty package skillfully administered by our team of talented cosmetologists. The last step in your adventure is our lounge, where you can enjoy a glass of wine and laughs with your friends.

Whether you're planning a special day out with friends, celebrating a birthday or wedding, or visiting Halifax, we promises to be an unforgettable experience!
